newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Finalists chosen in 1996 corporate accounts awards.
newsitem.headline: Finalists chosen in 1996 corporate accounts awards.

text.p: The finalists for the 1996 Chartered Accountants Published Accounts Awards, aimed at promoting high standards in Irish corporate reporting, were announced on Tuesday.
Irish companies shortlisted for the main award included CRH, Telecom Eireann, Aer Rianta, Northern Electricity, Greencore, Irish Life, James Crean and Lamont Holdings.
Relfex Group, UTV and Green Property all qualified in the category for companies with a turnover of up to 50 million Irish pounds.
The Irish Horse Racing Authority, the Irish Youth Foundation, third-word aid agency Concern and IDA Ireland were selected as finalists in the non-profit category.
There are also 15 finalists eligible for the Design Award, and a new award will honour financial reporting in the media.
The Leinster Society of Chartered Accountants, which organised the awards, said all finalists were selected after hundreds of annual reports were scrutinised.
The winners will be announced on November 20, 1996.
